title: Modular Default Rules. Rereading Hadley v. Baxendale and the Theory of Contractual Defaults

detail.title: Modular Default Rules. Rereading Hadley v. Baxendale and the Theory of Contractual Defaults
detail.abstract:
In the economic theory of contract, the rule of Hadley v. Baxendale is usually described as a default rule that excludes the recoverability of consequential damages and, in particular, as the paradigmatic example of a penalty default rule. On this reading, by excluding the recoverability of consequential damages, the rule requires promisees who seek broader coverage to contract around the default through a different contractual term. The rule is unwelcome to the majority of promisees, who would prefer a rule of full liability. This Article argues that this account fails to capture the rule’s actual structure. Hadley is not a rule that excludes consequential damages, but a default rule internally articulated into two modules: an ordinary module, which covers the losses arising naturally from the breach in the ordinary course of events, and an extended module, which covers special damages when the promisor had been informed of them, or had reason to know of the circumstances that made them foreseeable.

The rereading of Hadley yields a theoretical consequence of general character. It makes it possible to isolate a new type of default rule, here termed the “modular default rule.” By modular default rule is meant a rule that contains within itself several operative modules. The standard module governs the ordinary case and operates without any action by the parties. The extended module is triggered when one party makes knowable private circumstances capable of justifying a different liability regime. Communication is the condition that allows the default itself to extend its effects.

AI.tldr: 本文重新解读了哈德利诉巴克森代尔案的合同违约损害规则，指出该规则并非排除间接损害赔偿的惩罚性默认规则，而是一个内部包含普通模块和扩展模块的"模块化默认规则"。普通模块自动适用，覆盖违约直接造成的损失；扩展模块则在一方告知其特殊情形后被触发，覆盖特殊损害。
AI.research_question: 哈德利诉巴克森代尔案中的违约损害规则究竟具有怎样的制度结构？它是否真的是一个排除间接损害赔偿的惩罚性默认规则？
AI.motivation: 既有经济学合同理论将哈德利规则简单描述为排除间接损害赔偿的惩罚性默认规则，但这种解读未能准确捕捉该规则的实际结构，作者试图纠正这一误解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合同经济学理论中的默认规则理论；模块化默认规则（modular default rule）概念——一种内部包含多个可操作模块的规则，标准模块自动适用，扩展模块在一方披露私人信息后被触发。
AI.method: 法律文本分析与概念重构：通过对哈德利案规则结构的重新解读，提出新的理论分类。
AI.findings: 哈德利规则并非排除间接损害赔偿，而是由两个模块构成：普通模块（覆盖违约自然造成的损失，自动适用）和扩展模块（覆盖特别损害，当承诺人已告知或应知相关情形时触发）。从而识别出一种新的默认规则类型——模块化默认规则。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"模块化默认规则"这一新的概念类型，丰富了默认规则理论，为理解合同法的制度设计提供了新的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 有助于更准确地理解哈德利规则的实际运作方式，指导合同当事人如何通过信息披露来调整违约责任范围，对合同设计与风险分配具有实践启示。

title: Modular Default Rules. Rereading Hadley v. Baxendale and the Theory of Contractual Defaults

detail.title: Modular Default Rules. Rereading Hadley v. Baxendale and the Theory of Contractual Defaults
detail.abstract:
In the economic theory of contract, the rule of Hadley v. Baxendale is usually described as a default rule that excludes the recoverability of consequential damages and, in particular, as the paradigmatic example of a penalty default rule. On this reading, by excluding the recoverability of consequential damages, the rule requires promisees who seek broader coverage to contract around the default through a different contractual term. The rule is unwelcome to the majority of promisees, who would prefer a rule of full liability. This Article argues that this account fails to capture the rule’s actual structure. Hadley is not a rule that excludes consequential damages, but a default rule internally articulated into two modules: an ordinary module, which covers the losses arising naturally from the breach in the ordinary course of events, and an extended module, which covers special damages when the promisor had been informed of them, or had reason to know of the circumstances that made them foreseeable.

The rereading of Hadley yields a theoretical consequence of general character. It makes it possible to isolate a new type of default rule, here termed the “modular default rule.” By modular default rule is meant a rule that contains within itself several operative modules. The standard module governs the ordinary case and operates without any action by the parties. The extended module is triggered when one party makes knowable private circumstances capable of justifying a different liability regime. Communication is the condition that allows the default itself to extend its effects.

AI.tldr: 本文重新解读了合同法中著名的Hadley v. Baxendale规则，认为它并非排除间接损失的惩罚性默认规则，而是一种由普通模块和扩展模块构成的“模块化默认规则”。普通模块涵盖违约通常导致的损失，扩展模块则在被告知特殊情事时触发。这种新类型默认规则通过信息沟通自动调整责任范围。
AI.research_question: Hadley v. Baxendale规则的真实结构是什么？它是否属于一种新的默认规则类型？
AI.motivation: 传统理论将Hadley规则视为排除间接损失的惩罚性默认规则，但这一解读未能捕捉该规则的实际结构，有必要重新审视以揭示其真正的运作机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 默认规则理论（Default Rule Theory）；模块化默认规则（Modular Default Rule）
AI.method: 法律文本分析与理论重构
AI.findings: Hadley规则并非单一排除间接损失的规则，而是内部包含两个模块：普通模块（覆盖违约自然产生的损失）和扩展模块（在承诺人被告知特殊情事时覆盖特殊损失）。由此提炼出“模块化默认规则”这一新类型，其核心特征是通过沟通自动触发模块切换。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了“模块化默认规则”这一新概念，丰富了默认规则的类型学，并为理解合同法的沟通与信息披露功能提供了新的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为合同法实践中如何理解与适用Hadley规则提供了更准确的框架，提示当事人通过信息披露即可自动扩展违约损害赔偿范围，无需另行约定条款。

detail.abstract: Why do some digital products charge users directly (2C), while others rely on businessside monetization (2B)? Existing two-sided market and media economics literatures treat user heterogeneity as exogenous and assume 2C pricing is always feasible, focusing on "how to price" conditional on a given product architecture. They do not explain whether unified 2C pricing is structurally possible at all, nor why some product architectures systematically preclude it. This paper shifts the question from optimal pricing to contractual feasibility. Building on transaction cost theory, we argue that product architecture determines whether a firm can draw a coherent target customer persona. When a product bundles highly heterogeneous use cases (e.g., a superapp, a generalpurpose AI model), no single persona fits; unified 2C pricing becomes infeasible because the firm cannot effectively separate consumers by their willingness to pay at acceptable cost. Monetization then shifts to 2B channels or layered contracts. To isolate this mechanism, we employ an extreme-case design with within-firm comparisons (Tencent WeChat vs. its gaming and music units) and longitudinal changes (The New York Times before and after divestiture). Cross-industry evidence from media, platforms, software, and AI confirms that narrower, coherent products support 2C pricing, whereas broader, heterogeneous systems necessitate 2B models. This paper contributes by endogenizing user heterogeneity to observable product structure, moving beyond the abstract parameters of existing models. Furthermore, it extends the logic of audience clarity-originally confined to media economics-to digital platforms, open-source software, and generative AI, demonstrating that functional heterogeneity imposes similar structural.

AI.tldr: 本文从交易成本理论出发，提出产品架构决定企业能否绘制清晰的用户画像。当产品捆绑高度异质的使用场景时（如超级App、通用AI模型），统一的2C定价在结构上不可行，变现转而依赖2B渠道或分层合约。通过微信 vs. 游戏/音乐业务、纽约时报资产剥离前后的对比设计，以及跨行业证据验证了这一机制。
AI.research_question: 为什么有些数字产品直接向用户收费（2C），而另一些则依赖企业端变现（2B）？统一2C定价在何种条件下在结构上可行？
AI.motivation: 现有双边市场和媒体经济学文献将用户异质性视为外生给定，并假设2C定价总是可行的，只关注"给定产品架构下如何定价"，未能解释为什么某些产品架构在结构上排除了统一2C定价的可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 交易成本理论。核心论点：产品架构决定企业能否绘制连贯的目标客户画像（target customer persona）。当产品捆绑高度异质的使用场景时，单一画像无法适用，企业无法在可接受的成本下有效区分消费者的支付意愿。
AI.method: 极端案例设计，包含：(1) 企业内比较（腾讯微信 vs. 其游戏和音乐单元）；(2) 纵向变化分析（纽约时报资产剥离前后）；(3) 跨行业证据（媒体、平台、软件、AI）。
AI.findings: 更窄、更连贯的产品支持2C定价；更宽泛、更异质的系统需要2B模式。产品功能异质性对变现模式施加了结构性的约束。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将用户异质性内生化于可观察的产品结构，超越了现有模型中的抽象参数；(2) 将"受众清晰度"（audience clarity）逻辑从媒体经济学扩展到数字平台、开源软件和生成式AI领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字产品企业在商业模式设计（2C vs. 2B）上提供产品架构层面的结构约束条件分析框架，帮助企业理解何时统一2C定价在结构上不可行。

detail.abstract: How do medium-small post-Soviet states construct strategic autonomy that exceeds what their structural endowments predict-and what mechanisms sustain it? Existing frameworks of multi-vectorism, shelter theory, and rentier state analysis each leave causal mechanisms underspecified. This article proposes 'principled sovereignty,' derived from a deviant case design and within-case process tracing across three accountability episodes (Iran 2023; Russia/AZAL 2024-2026; Nakhchivan 2026). Four features, deployed simultaneously and in temporal sequence, generate structural leverage that no single feature produces alone: sovereign fiscal insulation; territorial non-negotiability anchored in multilateral mandates; legalistic accountability mechanisms applied consistently against larger neighbours; and multidimensional structural leverage through pipeline diversification, downstream capital integration, and transit corridor positioning. The framework specifies its scope conditions, the intermediate process evidence distinguishing mechanism from retrospective description, and what would falsify it. Against Kazakhstan-which shares features 1 and 4 but accommodated privately when Russia disrupted CPC oil exports in 2022 rather than escalating publicly-and Georgia-which pursues feature 2 without features 1 or 4 and has failed at territorial enforcement for seventeen years-the framework generates differentiated predictions the empirical record confirms. The primary contribution is threefold: the relational-structural distinction within multi-vectorism; the specification of experienced presidential statecraft as the architect of the institutional portfolio-Aliyev's legal-diplomatic formation and energy infrastructure background help account for why the architecture took its specific form; and the argument that strategic autonomy emerged from the interaction of leadership, institutions, resources, geography, and structural opportunity rather than from any single factor alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"原则性主权"框架，解释中等小型后苏联国家如何通过四种机制（财政独立、领土不可谈判、法律问责、多维结构杠杆）的组合运用，构建超出其结构性禀赋预期的战略自主。通过阿塞拜疆的案例追踪（伊朗2023、俄罗斯/AZAL 2024-2026、纳希切万2026）及与哈萨克斯坦、格鲁吉亚的比较验证该框架。
AI.research_question: 中等小型后苏联国家如何构建超出其结构性禀赋所预测的战略自主？维持这种战略自主的机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有理论（多向量主义、庇护理论、食利国分析）对因果机制的描述不够明确，无法解释某些中小型后苏联国家为何能获得超出预期的战略自主。
AI.theoretical_framework: "原则性主权"框架：四种特征的组合（主权财政隔离、基于多边授权的领土不可谈判性、针对大邻国持续运用的法律问责机制、通过管道多元化/下游资本整合/中转走廊定位实现的多维结构杠杆）单独使用时效果有限，但同时并按时间序列部署时可产生结构性杠杆。
AI.method: 偏离案例设计（deviant case design）与案例内过程追踪，涵盖三个问责事件（伊朗2023；俄罗斯/AZAL 2024-2026；纳希切万2026），并与哈萨克斯坦和格鲁吉亚进行受控比较。
AI.findings: 阿塞拜疆通过四项机制的组合运用获得了超出结构性预期的战略自主；哈萨克斯坦仅具备特征1和4但未在2022年俄罗斯中断CPC石油出口时公开升级；格鲁吉亚追求特征2但缺乏特征1和4，十七年来未能实现领土执法。框架生成的分化预测与经验记录一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 三重贡献：多向量主义中的关系-结构区分；经验丰富的总统治国术作为制度组合的设计者——阿利耶夫的法律外交背景和能源基础设施经验有助于解释为何该架构采取特定形式；战略自主源于领导力、制度、资源、地理与结构机会的互动，而非单一因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中等小型国家的战略自主构建提供了可操作的机制框架和边界条件，明确了可证伪的标准和中间过程证据，对理解后苏联空间的地缘政治动态具有政策参考价值。

title: Liquidity-Based Audit of Algorithmic Trading Strategies

detail.title: Liquidity-Based Audit of Algorithmic Trading Strategies
detail.abstract: We show that net demand for liquidity by algo strategies is identifiable from its trade and price history alone, with no knowledge of its signal or optimization problem. An exact multi-period regret decomposition implies that the sign of this statistic classifies a linear strategy as a net liquidity consumer or provider, recovering the Kyle (1985) informed-trader/market-maker dichotomy from observables alone. Under an AR(1) cost process, the same statistic equals the product of strategy size and the squared Roll (1984) implied spread, making the correction a direct proxy for prevailing illiquidity. Extending to endogenous price impact and aggregating across N correlated strategies yields a liquidity-balance condition whose violation produces welfare loss scaling as N squared, a closed-form fire-sale externality. We calibrate to CRSP equity data (2016-2025), tracking implied spreads through the COVID-19 and 2022 rate-shock episodes, with an estimator computable in O(Tnd) time.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，仅从算法策略的交易和价格历史数据中即可识别其流动性净需求，无需知晓其信号或优化问题。通过精确的多期遗憾分解，该统计量的符号可将线性策略分类为净流动性消费者或提供者，从可观测数据中恢复Kyle(1985)的知情交易者/做市商二分法。在AR(1)成本过程下，该统计量等于策略规模与Roll(1984)隐含价差平方的乘积，使修正项成为当前流动性的直接代理变量。扩展到内生价格冲击和N个相关策略的聚合，得到流动性平衡条件，其违背将产生N平方量级的福利损失（一种封闭形式的火灾甩卖外部性）。作者使用CRSP股票数据（2016-2025）进行校准，跟踪COVID-19和2022年利率冲击期间的隐含价差，估计器可在O(Tnd)时间内计算。
AI.research_question: 如何仅从可观测的交易和价格历史数据中识别算法策略的流动性净需求，并对策略进行流动性消费者/提供者的分类？
AI.motivation: 传统文献中区分知情交易者和做市商需要知道交易者的信号或优化问题，而实际中这些信息通常不可观测。本文旨在建立一种仅从公开可观测数据即可识别算法策略流动性角色的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: Kyle(1985)模型的市场微观结构理论、Roll(1984)隐含价差模型、多期遗憾分解、AR(1)成本过程、内生价格冲击模型、火灾甩卖外部性理论。
AI.method: 理论推导结合实证校准。推导了精确的多期遗憾分解，建立统计量与流动性净需求的关系；在AR(1)成本过程下连接Roll隐含价差；扩展到多策略均衡；使用CRSP 2016-2025年数据进行实证校准。
AI.findings: 1) 仅从交易和价格历史可识别策略的流动性净需求；2) 该统计量的符号可分类流动性消费者/提供者；3) 在AR(1)成本下该统计量等于策略规模×Roll隐含价差平方；4) 多策略聚合下存在N平方量级的火灾甩卖外部性；5) 实证中成功跟踪了COVID-19和2022年利率冲击期间的流动性变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了从可观测数据识别策略流动性角色的理论框架，将Kyle(1985)的二分法从不可观测信号扩展到可观测交易数据；揭示了多策略相互作用下的N平方福利损失外部性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可在O(Tnd)时间内计算的流动性需求估计器，可实时跟踪市场流动性状况；对监管机构识别系统性流动性风险、防范火灾甩卖具有实践意义。

title: Economic Representations

detail.title: Economic Representations
detail.abstract: Valuations depend on how people categorize, perceive, or otherwise represent economic objects. This paper develops a measure of how the market represents firms, and uses this measure to study stock valuations. I train an algorithm to structure language from financial news into embeddings—vectors that quantify economic features and themes in each firm's news coverage. I show that a firm's vector representation is informative of how the market perceives its business model. Representations explain cross-sectional variation in stock valuations, cash flow forecasts, and return correlations. Changes in representation help to explain changes in stock prices. Some changes in representations and prices are forecastable, and suggest that some of the explained variation in stock valuations stems from misperception. Misperception and misvaluation can intensify when a firm's news coverage includes attention-drawing features—like "internet" in the late 1990s or "AI" in the early 2020s.

AI.tldr: 本文通过训练算法将财经新闻转化为向量嵌入（embeddings），量化市场对公司的经济特征和主题表征，发现这些表征能解释股票估值、现金流预测和收益回报的横截面差异，且当新闻包含“互联网”（90年代末）或“AI”（2020年代初）等吸引注意力特征时，误判和误估值会加剧。
AI.research_question: 市场如何表征（represent）公司，这种表征如何影响股票估值？
AI.motivation: 传统估值研究关注基本面因素，但忽视了一个关键问题：估值依赖于人们如何分类、感知或“表征”经济对象。本文希望从语义层面量化市场对公司的表征，并检验其与估值的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于表征理论（representations）和注意力经济（attention economics），结合自然语言处理中的嵌入（embeddings）方法，将新闻文本转化为可量化的经济特征向量。
AI.method: 训练算法从财经新闻中提取文本嵌入（embeddings），量化每家公司在新闻中的经济特征和主题。通过横截面回归和时间序列分析，检验表征与估值、现金流预测、收益相关性之间的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 公司向量表征能反映市场对其商业模式的感知。2. 表征可解释股票估值、现金流预测和收益相关性的横截面差异。3. 表征变化有助于解释股价变化。4. 部分表征和价格变化是可预测的，表明部分估值差异源于误判（misperception）。5. 当新闻包含“互联网”（90年代末）或“AI”（2020年代初）等吸引注意力的特征时，误判和误估值会加剧。
AI.theory_contributions: 将认知科学的“表征”概念引入金融经济学，从语义层面量化市场对公司的感知，丰富了行为金融学中关于投资者认知与资产定价的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和监管者提供了一种量化市场“叙事”和“认知”的工具，可用于识别潜在的误估值风险，特别是在注意力驱动的市场热点时期。

title: Environmental Degradation and Equity Return Alpha using Satellite Imagery

detail.title: Environmental Degradation and Equity Return Alpha using Satellite Imagery

contentType.other: Preprint on SSRN prior to publish.

detail.abstract:
The academic and commercial use of satellite imagery and geospatial data has expanded rapidly since the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) began providing public access in the late 1990s. While most applications have focused on geology and energy estimation, the potential use of satellite data in financial analysis remains less explored. r 

This paper combines official CO₂ emissions data with satellite-based measures of energy consumption to examine the relationship between environmental degradation and stock returns, and to assess whether reductions in environmental degradation are associated with positive abnormal returns (alpha). Existing ESG-related asset pricing studies predominantly rely on published statistical data. 

We find consistent evidence across both data sources that reductions in environmental degradation are associated with higher alpha. These findings motivate further investigation into whether satellite data can complement-or, in data-scarce settings, substitute for-official statistics, thereby improving the feasibility of ESG and climate-related financial analysis in ministates and developing economies where published data are often limited.

AI.tldr: 本文利用卫星影像数据与官方CO₂排放数据，研究发现环境退化程度的降低与股票异常正回报（alpha）相关，并探讨卫星数据在数据稀缺地区替代官方统计的潜力。
AI.research_question: 环境退化与股票回报之间的关系如何？卫星数据能否补充或替代官方统计用于ESG金融分析？
AI.motivation: 卫星影像数据在金融分析中的应用尚不充分；现有ESG资产定价研究主要依赖官方统计数据，而许多小型经济体和发展中经济体缺乏此类数据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境退化与资产定价理论；卫星数据作为ESG信息替代来源的有效性。
AI.method: 将官方CO₂排放数据与卫星测度的能源消耗数据相结合，对股票回报进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 基于两种数据源均发现，环境退化程度的降低与更高的股票异常回报（alpha）相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了卫星数据在金融与ESG研究中的应用边界；验证了环境绩效与股票回报之间的正向关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数据稀缺地区（如微型国家和发展中经济体）提供ESG气候金融分析的可行替代方案；促进卫星数据在可持续投资中的实际应用。

title: Distributed Solar-compute Infrastructure: An Integrated Multi-objective Energy System Architecture for Decarbonisation, Sovereign AI Capacity, and Grid Resilience

detail.title: Distributed Solar-compute Infrastructure: An Integrated Multi-objective Energy System Architecture for Decarbonisation, Sovereign AI Capacity, and Grid Resilience
detail.abstract:
Modern economies face three converging infrastructure challenges: accelerating residential
decarbonisation, expanding sovereign artificial intelligence (AI) compute capacity at pace, and
maintaining grid resilience under rising renewable penetration. This paper presents a
generalisable, layered system architecture that addresses all three simultaneously through the
integration of distributed rooftop solar photovoltaic (PV) generation, battery storage,
concentrated compute hubs, electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure, and operator-level
orchestration via virtual power purchase agreements (vPPAs).
The core mechanism couples distributed solar generation to local compute workloads, creating
multiple concurrent revenue streams — self-consumption savings, compute rental income, grid
flexibility payments, and Smart Export Guarantee (SEG) export receipts — that materially
improve household-level payback periods. Detailed unit economic modelling using 2026 UK
input data demonstrates net cash gross margins of £303–£2,829 per home per year depending
on solar yield and GPU compute rental rate, with operator simple payback of 6–11 years under
a mid-range scenario. A sensitivity analysis confirms the architecture crosses economic
viability thresholds (net gross margin >£1,000/yr) at GPU spot rates of £0.50/hr and above for
typical UK solar yield ranges. The infrastructure deployment entity — termed throughout this
paper the Local Infrastructure Operator (LIO) — can be a local authority, housing association, energy retailer, university, NHS trust, or any organisation with the requisite asset ownership
and accountability to residents.
Beyond household economics, the architecture delivers measurable systemic benefits. At scale
(100,000 participating homes per region), residential demand reduction equivalent to
approximately 40 MW of average grid capacity is estimated, directly creating headroom for
hyperscale datacenter connections in the same Distribution Network Operator (DNO) regions.
Technology readiness assessment confirms all core components are pilot-ready today. The
architecture is designed as complementary to, not competitive with, centralised AI Growth
Zone buildout. Limitations, failure modes, equity considerations, and open research questions
are discussed. Real-world pilot validation at LIO scale is the recommended next step.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分层系统架构，通过整合分布式屋顶光伏、电池储能、集中式计算中心、电动汽车充电设施及虚拟购电协议（vPPA），同时解决住宅脱碳、AI算力扩张和电网韧性三大基础设施挑战。该架构通过将分布式太阳能发电与本地计算负载耦合，创造多重收入流，显著改善家庭投资回报期。以2026年英国数据建模显示，每户年净现金毛利£303–£2,829，运营商简单回收期6–11年。区域规模部署（10万户）可减少约40MW平均电网容量需求，为超大规模数据中心腾出空间。
AI.research_question: 如何通过一个通用、分层的系统架构，同时解决住宅脱碳、AI计算能力扩张和电网韧性三大基础设施挑战？
AI.motivation: 现代经济体面临三大交叉基础设施挑战：加速住宅脱碳、快速扩展主权AI算力、在可再生能源渗透率上升下维持电网韧性。现有方案往往各自为政，缺乏协同。本文旨在提出一种可同时应对三者的集成架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分布式能源与计算负载耦合理论、多重收入流模型、虚拟购电协议（vPPA）运营机制、家庭级单位经济学建模。架构以"本地基础设施运营商（LIO）"为核心组织实体。
AI.method: 详细单位经济学建模，使用2026年英国输入数据；敏感性分析检验经济可行性阈值；技术就绪度评估；规模效益推估（10万户区域）。
AI.findings: 1) 每户年净现金毛利£303–£2,829，取决于太阳能产量和GPU算力租赁费率；2) GPU现货费率≥£0.50/小时时，架构跨越经济可行性阈值（净毛利>£1,000/年）；3) 运营商中等情景下简单回收期6–11年；4) 区域规模部署（10万户）可减少约40MW平均电网容量需求，为超大规模数据中心创造接入空间；5) 所有核心组件技术就绪度达到可试点水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了分布式能源与计算负载耦合的系统架构理论，建立了多重收入流叠加的家庭级经济模型，为基础设施多目标协同提供了可泛化的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种可立即试点的工程架构方案，明确了LIO（地方当局、住房协会、大学等）的可操作主体身份，给出了2026年英国条件下的具体经济指标和敏感性边界，对政策制定者和基础设施投资者具有直接参考价值。

title: The Price of Intelligence
affiliations: University of Tulsa - Collins College of Business and Auburn University - Department of Finance

detail.title: The Price of Intelligence
detail.abstract: We construct price indexes for AI inference using posted prices, marketplace usage, and benchmark scores from the public API market. The indexes translate token prices into the cost of benchmarked model capability, giving researchers an input price for studying AI adoption, productivity, labor demand, competition, inflation measurement, firm investment, and policy analysis. From January 2025 to June 2026, prices for continuing models rise by 6.5%, while the fixed-quality price of inference falls by 51.9% and the usage-weighted cost per unit of capability falls by 86.8%. Decomposing the decline shows that it comes from new models entering the market and buyers switching to them, not from existing models cutting prices. The results show how rapid product turnover changes the measured price of AI capability and provide a reusable index for economic and financial research.

AI.tldr: 本文利用公开API市场的标价、使用量和基准评分，构建了AI推理的价格指数。研究发现，2025年1月至2026年6月间，虽然持续存在的模型价格微涨6.5%，但固定质量下的推理价格下降51.9%，单位能力的加权成本下降86.8%。成本下降主要源于新模型进入市场及用户转向新模型，而非现有模型降价。
AI.research_question: 如何构建衡量AI推理能力价格变化的指数？AI推理的真实成本在快速变化的市场中如何演变？
AI.motivation: AI推理服务的价格是研究AI采用、生产力、劳动力需求、竞争、通胀测度、企业投资和政策分析的关键投入价格，但目前缺乏系统性的价格指数来量化其变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价格指数理论（固定质量价格指数、拉氏/帕氏指数）；AI能力基准测试与定价的关系；产品快速更替对价格测度的影响。
AI.method: 利用公开API市场的标价、实际使用数据和模型基准评分，构建价格指数。通过分解方法区分价格变化来自现有模型调价还是新模型进入与用户切换。
AI.findings: 2025年1月至2026年6月，持续模型价格上升6.5%，固定质量推理价格下降51.9%，单位能力加权成本下降86.8%。成本下降主要归因于新模型进入和用户向新模型迁移，而非现有模型降价。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了可复用的AI推理价格指数构建方法，揭示了产品快速更替如何改变AI能力的测量价格，为经济金融研究提供基础工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者提供AI采用、生产率、劳动力需求、竞争、通胀、投资和政策分析的关键输入价格度量；为企业和政策制定者理解AI成本结构变化提供实证依据。

title: Deep Analysis in Excel without VBA: New Functionality Could Validate AI Answers or Replace them Altogether
affiliations: University of Richmond - E. Claiborne Robins School of Business and University of Otago - Department of Accountancy and Finance

detail.title: Deep Analysis in Excel without VBA: New Functionality Could Validate AI Answers or Replace them Altogether
detail.abstract: You can exploit your current knowledge of Excel's formula language to build customized Excel functions. These user-defined functions are so fast and transparent that they may be useful for validating AI answers or replacing them altogether. You can now use loops that previously required VBA or JavaScript. The functions use Excel's new =LAMBDA and =MAKEARRAY functions. You can assign personalized names to functions and their input variables, and they are portable between Workbooks. We present simple examples showing basic syntax, building up to a compact fixed income example: a user-defined function using a Taylor series to estimate the change in a bond's price given a given change in yield-to-maturity, where you choose how many terms of the Taylor series to include.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了如何利用Excel的LAMBDA和MAKEARRAY函数构建自定义函数，无需VBA或JavaScript即可实现循环操作，并以债券价格泰勒级数估计为示例，展示了用户自定义函数在金融计算中的应用。
AI.research_question: 如何利用Excel的LAMBDA和MAKEARRAY函数构建用户自定义函数，以替代传统编程语言（如VBA/JavaScript）实现循环和复杂计算？
AI.motivation: Excel用户通常需要借助VBA或JavaScript实现循环和复杂函数，但这些方法不够便捷和透明。新引入的LAMBDA函数允许用户在Excel公式语言中直接定义函数，提高效率、可移植性和透明度。
AI.theoretical_framework: Excel公式语言；LAMBDA函数；MAKEARRAY函数；泰勒级数展开；固定收益证券定价理论。
AI.method: 通过从简单到复杂的示例逐步展示LAMBDA和MAKEARRAY函数的用法，最终构建一个利用泰勒级数估计债券价格变动的自定义函数，用户可以自由选择泰勒级数的项数。
AI.findings: 用户可以直接在Excel公式语言中构建自定义函数，无需VBA/JavaScript；自定义函数速度快、透明、可移植；以债券价格变化估计为例，展示了自定义函数在金融领域的实际应用价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统展示了Excel LAMBDA函数在构建用户自定义函数方面的理论基础和语法规则，拓展了Excel公式语言的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融从业者提供了一种无需编程即可实现复杂计算（如债券价格敏感性分析）的方法；用户自定义函数可快速验证AI生成答案的正确性，甚至完全替代AI在某些场景下的输出。

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个简洁的闭式解模型，用于分析当可变可再生能源（VRE）远离负荷中心时，输电容量、可再生能源装机容量与自愿弃风（光）之间的最优平衡关系。研究发现，弃电的边际成本是平均成本的三倍以上，若输电扩展不足，弃电率将快速上升。模型以英国陆上风电为例进行校准，发现架空线路对弃电水平影响有限，而海底电缆的高成本会使进一步扩展苏格兰风电变得不经济。
AI.research_question: 当可变可再生能源远离负荷中心时，如何实现输电扩容、可再生能源容量与自愿弃电之间的最优平衡？
AI.motivation: VRE通常远离负荷中心，弃电的边际成本远高于平均成本（3倍以上），若输电扩展不足，弃电率将快速上升。现有研究缺乏简洁的解析解来指导这一平衡决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于简化的距离模型，推导闭式解；需求中心均衡分析；独立于市场价格，仅依赖成本与技术参数。
AI.method: 数学建模与闭式解推导，结合英国陆上风电数据进行校准分析。
AI.findings: （1）闭式解独立于市场价格，仅取决于成本和技术参数；（2）若本地并网储能可覆盖大部分成本，共址储能可增加陆上风电利润并降低最优出口容量；（3）架空线路对苏格兰风电的弃电/拥堵水平影响不大；（4）英国海底电缆的高成本导致高效弃电水平上升，使得进一步扩展苏格兰风电不再有利可图。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出输电扩容、可再生能源容量与自愿弃电之间最优平衡的闭式解公式，揭示了弃电边际成本与平均成本之间的巨大差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和电网规划者提供了量化工具，以评估不同输电技术（如架空线路与海底电缆）对可再生能源扩展可行性的影响；指出共址储能的经济优势。

title: NONLINEARITIES AND POTENTIAL FRACTIONAL EQULIBRIA IN THE SPOT/FUTURE OIL PRICES RELATIONSHIP
affiliations: University of Huelva, University of Navarra - Department of Economics and University of Valencia

detail.title: NONLINEARITIES AND POTENTIAL FRACTIONAL EQULIBRIA IN THE SPOT/FUTURE OIL PRICES RELATIONSHIP
detail.abstract: In this paper, we examine the long-run relationship between spot and future oil prices by considering nonlinearity, a potentially non-integer degree of integration, and allowing both canonical and fractional cointegration methods to compete for the best data fit. We also apply an ex-ante unit root test with endogenous break detection and a pre-break and post-break approach to compare canonical and fractional vector error correction models. Bridging a gap between nonlinear and fractional applications, this methodology handles nonlinearities in the long-run equilibrium without resorting to state-space or exogenous regime-switching models, while smooth and persistent long-run dynamics can be captured without assuming full nonstationarity. Using weekly observations of spot and future prices from the U.S. Energy Information Administration, our estimates identify a structural break around 2004. The canonical contango situation detectable across the whole series breaks down upon examining the data's memory processes before and after this break. Our results also reveal a significant shift in the equilibrium model linking spot to future oil prices due to a global exogenous shock, suggesting two different, time-dependent equilibria: a backwardation equilibrium before the break and a near-unity contango after. This evidence demonstrates that global shocks can affect the spot-futures oil price relationship, inducing equilibrium switches.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了原油现货与期货价格之间的长期关系，采用非线性、分数阶积分及协整方法，发现2004年前后存在结构性断点，导致均衡从现货溢价（backwardation）转为接近1:1的期货溢价（contango），说明全球性冲击会引发均衡切换。
AI.research_question: 原油现货与期货价格之间的长期均衡关系如何？全球性冲击是否会改变这一均衡关系？
AI.motivation: 传统线性协整方法无法充分捕捉原油现货-期货价格关系中可能存在的非线性、分数阶积分以及结构性断点，需要更灵活的方法来刻画其长期动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非线性协整、分数阶协整、向量误差修正模型（VECM）、结构性断点检测。
AI.method: 使用美国能源信息署的周度现货和期货价格数据，结合先验单位根检验（含内生断点检测）、断点前后分析方法，比较经典协整与分数阶协整向量误差修正模型。
AI.findings: 识别出2004年前后的结构性断点；断点前为现货溢价（backwardation）均衡，断点后转为接近1:1的期货溢价（contango）均衡；全球性冲击导致均衡发生切换。
AI.theory_contributions: 弥合了非线性与分数阶应用之间的研究空白，提出了一种无需状态空间或外生机制转换模型即可处理长期均衡非线性的方法，同时能捕捉平滑且持久的长期动态。
AI.practical_contributions: 为原油市场参与者和政策制定者提供了理解全球性冲击如何改变现货-期货价格关系的实证依据，有助于优化套期保值策略和风险管理。

title: How internal capital markets react to natural disasters? Evidence from multi-segment firms

detail.title: How internal capital markets react to natural disasters? Evidence from multi-segment firms
detail.abstract: This paper examines how corporations respond to natural disasters in terms of their internal capital markets using a sample of US listed firms from 2001 to 2020. We find that firms allocate capital less efficiently following natural disasters. In particular, the results of our additional analyses indicate a reduction in firm risk following such occurrences. This supports the emergence of risk-reduction and corporate socialism arguments that firms prioritize financial stability over optimal resource distribution by adopting more conservative strategies to stabilise cash flows and reduce risk at the cost of less efficient capital allocation. We also show that the effect of national disasters on internal capital market efficiency is more pronounced in financially constrained firms, suggesting that limited access to external financing amplifies risk-averse allocation strategies. In addition, we find that firms with CEO duality exhibit more severe declines in allocation efficiency, underscoring the role of governance structure and the concentration of decision-making. Finally, our results further prove that adopting a conservative capital allocation strategy may amplify the excess value of firms with financial constraints. These findings have important implications for corporate financial policies and disaster resilience strategies, highlighting the need for firms to balance short-term financial stability with long-term investment efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文以2001-2020年美国上市公司为样本，研究了企业如何通过内部资本市场应对自然灾害，发现自然灾害后企业资本配置效率下降，企业倾向于采取保守策略以降低风险，牺牲了最优资源配置。
AI.research_question: 自然灾害如何影响企业的内部资本市场配置效率？
AI.motivation: 自然灾害日益频发，但现有文献较少关注企业如何通过内部资本市场调整资源配置以应对灾害冲击，尤其是风险规避与效率权衡的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内部资本市场理论、风险规避理论、企业社会主义（Corporate Socialism）理论、委托代理理论
AI.method: 以2001-2020年美国上市公司为样本，采用实证回归分析，检验自然灾害对内部资本市场效率的影响，并进行异质性分析（财务约束、CEO二元性）和超额价值分析。
AI.findings: 1. 自然灾害后企业资本配置效率下降；2. 企业风险降低，支持风险规避和企业社会主义逻辑；3. 财务约束企业影响更显著；4. CEO二元性加剧效率下降；5. 保守配置策略可能放大财务约束企业的超额价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 将自然灾害冲击引入内部资本市场效率研究，揭示了企业在外部冲击下"风险规避vs.效率"的权衡机制，丰富了企业社会主义理论在实证研究中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业制定灾后财务政策提供了启示，提醒企业在短期财务稳定与长期投资效率之间寻求平衡，并关注治理结构（如CEO二元性）在危机决策中的作用。

title: How downstream extreme heat shocks affect firm productivity
affiliations: Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE), affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: How downstream extreme heat shocks affect firm productivity
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how downstream extreme heat shocks propagate through supply chains and impair upstream firm productivity. Specifically, we use a comprehensive sample of Chinese A-share listed companies over the period 2009–2023 to estimate the effects of major customers’ extreme heat shocks on firm-level total factor productivity (TFP). We find that major customers’ exposure to extreme heat shocks leads to a statistically and economically significant decline in firms’ TFP. Mechanism analyses show that downstream extreme heat shocks impair firm productivity by disrupting working capital circulation and worsening financial constraints. Cross-sectional analyses indicate that the adverse effect is stronger for firms with weaker innovation capability, lower digitalization levels, higher demand uncertainty, those operating in more competitive industries, and non-state-owned enterprises. Overall, the results underscore supply chains as a key conduit through which localized extreme heat shocks transmit upstream to profoundly impair corporate productivity.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2009-2023年中国A股上市公司数据，发现下游客户的极端高温冲击会通过供应链传导至上游，显著降低企业的全要素生产率。机制在于冲击破坏了营运资本周转并加剧融资约束。异质性分析表明，创新能力弱、数字化水平低、需求不确定性高、处于竞争激烈行业以及非国有企业受影响更大。
AI.research_question: 下游极端高温冲击如何通过供应链传导并削弱上游企业的生产率？
AI.motivation: 极端天气事件日益频繁，但现有文献主要关注高温对当地企业的直接影响，忽视了通过供应链渠道的间接传导效应。本文旨在揭示供应链如何成为局部气候冲击向上游传播的关键通道。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链传导理论、营运资本管理理论、融资约束理论。
AI.method: 使用2009-2023年中国A股上市公司面板数据，以主要客户的极端高温暴露作为解释变量，估计其对供应商全要素生产率（TFP）的影响。采用固定效应模型进行基准回归，并进行了机制检验和异质性分析。
AI.findings: （1）下游客户的极端高温冲击显著降低了供应商的TFP，结果在统计和经济意义上均显著；（2）机制上，下游高温冲击通过扰乱营运资本周转和加剧融资约束来损害企业生产率；（3）异质性上，对于创新能力弱、数字化水平低、需求不确定性高、处于竞争激烈行业以及非国有企业，负面效应更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 将气候经济学与供应链管理理论相结合，首次系统论证了极端高温冲击通过供应链渠道向上游传导的微观机制，拓展了气候变化对企业生产率影响的研究视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示企业管理者和政策制定者关注供应链中气候风险的间接传导效应，特别是在评估企业气候韧性时应考虑上下游关联风险；为加强供应链风险管理、提升数字化水平和创新能力以应对气候冲击提供了实证依据。

title: AI, Innovation and the Future of the Patent System
affiliations: Technische Universität Berlin (TU Berlin) and

detail.title: AI, Innovation and the Future of the Patent System

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors are grateful to Bowman Heiden (TSI Executive Director), Wayne Stacy (BCLT Executive Director) and the members of the Berkeley Fellowship Program's Academic Council and Industry Research Council for their guidance throughout the project. The authors gratefully acknowledge the contributions of the experts listed in Annex B, who participated in the semi-structured interviews. Without their time and substantive input this study would not have been possible.
declarations.funderStatement: We are grateful for the funding received by the Berkeley Fellowship Program's Academic Council.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is reshaping how inventions are created and how the value of innovation is appropriated, raising fundamental questions for the patent system. Drawing on twenty-seven semistructured interviews with practitioners operating at the frontier of AI-intensive research and development, intellectual property strategy, and patent practice across the United States and Europe, this paper examines two analytically distinct questions: how patents affect AI innovation, and how AI affects the patent system. It finds that the most commercially valuable AI assets, including training data, model weights, and engineering pipelines, are typically protected through trade secrecy rather than patents, with firms combining protection mechanisms across the layers of the technology stack. At the same time, AI tools are transforming patent workflows, including translation, prior art search, drafting, and examination. AI is also placing pressure on core patent doctrines, including the person-skilled-in-the-art standard, inventive step, disclosure, and inventorship. The paper introduces two conceptual frameworksthe Patentability-Value Gap and the Volume-Cost Scenario Matrixas tools for structuring future research and policy discussion, and embeds comparative observations on the USPTO and EPO throughout. The analysis is exploratory and is offered as a structured snapshot of expert perspectives during a formative period, with each chapter identifying open questions for further empirical, doctrinal, and policy research.

AI.tldr: 本文基于27位前沿实践者的半结构化访谈，探讨专利如何影响AI创新、AI如何影响专利制度这两个问题。研究发现：最有商业价值的AI资产通常通过商业秘密而非专利保护；AI工具正变革专利工作流程；AI对专利核心原则带来压力。论文提出了"可专利性-价值差距"和"数量-成本情景矩阵"两个概念框架。
AI.research_question: (1) 专利如何影响AI创新？(2) AI如何影响专利制度？
AI.motivation: 人工智能正在重塑发明创造方式和创新价值获取方式，对现行专利制度提出了根本性挑战，但学界对此尚缺乏系统性的实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可专利性-价值差距（Patentability-Value Gap）；数量-成本情景矩阵（Volume-Cost Scenario Matrix）
AI.method: 对27位来自美国与欧洲、活跃在AI密集研发、知识产权战略和专利实践前沿的从业者进行半结构化访谈。
AI.findings: (1) 最有商业价值的AI资产（训练数据、模型权重、工程管线）通常通过商业秘密而非专利保护；(2) 企业结合多种保护机制覆盖技术栈各层；(3) AI工具正变革专利翻译、现有技术检索、撰写和审查等流程；(4) AI对"本领域普通技术人员"标准、创造性步骤、公开充分性和发明人资格等核心专利原则构成压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"可专利性-价值差距"和"数量-成本情景矩阵"两个概念框架，为未来研究和政策讨论提供结构化工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为专利政策制定者、企业知识产权战略制定者和法律从业者提供了在AI时代如何调整专利实践的探索性见解，包含USPTO与EPO的比较观察。

title: Urban Land Use Efficiency and Air Pollution: Spatial Effects, Mechanisms, and Heterogeneity —— Evidence from 285 Chinese Cities
affiliations: Zhongnan University of Economics and Law, Zhongnan University of Economics and Law, Zhongnan University of Economics and Law, Zhongnan University of Economics and Law and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Urban Land Use Efficiency and Air Pollution: Spatial Effects, Mechanisms, and Heterogeneity —— Evidence from 285 Chinese Cities
detail.abstract: Air pollution has emerged as a significant environmental determinant impacting public health. A substantial correlation exists between urban land use and air pollution. Analyzing the spatial disparities in the efficiency of urban land use and its influence on air pollution contributes to the adoption of efficient, eco-friendly, and low-carbon urban land practices and enhances the public environment. This study employs the undesirable SBM model to assess the land use efficiency across 285 Chinese cities and applies the spatial Durbin model to explore the impact and heterogeneity of urban land use efficiency on air pollution. The findings indicate the following: (1) China's urban land use efficiency is on an upward trend, but there are obvious characteristics of stage changes and spatial differentiation; (2) The spatial distribution of urban SO2 and PM2.5 concentrations has undergone significant alterations, exhibiting distinct settlement patterns; (3) Urban land use efficiency exerts a negative influence on air pollution, with a pronounced spatial spillover effect; (4) Furthermore, urban land use efficiency in China primarily influences air pollution levels through the dimensions of land input scale, development intensity, output intensity and green technology innovation; (5) Additionally, the impact and mechanisms of urban land use efficiency on air pollution levels in China display heterogeneity, influenced by factors such as the stage of urban development, geographical positioning, and scale. In conclusion, urban land use efficiency influences air pollution from both input and output perspectives. It is imperative to take into account a comprehensive set of factors including the urban development stage, geographical location, and scale, and to specifically refine the urban land use structure and spatial configuration to foster concurrent advancements in both urban land use efficiency and air quality.

AI.tldr: 本文利用非期望SBM模型和空间杜宾模型，分析了2003-2018年中国285个城市的土地利用效率及其对空气污染的影响，发现土地利用效率提升能显著降低空气污染，并存在空间溢出效应和异质性特征。
AI.research_question: 中国城市土地利用效率如何影响空气污染？这种影响是否存在空间溢出效应和异质性？
AI.motivation: 空气污染是重大公共健康威胁，而城市土地利用与空气污染密切相关。理解土地利用效率对空气污染的影响机制，有助于推动高效、环保、低碳的城市土地利用方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 土地利用效率理论、空间溢出效应理论、环境库兹涅茨曲线（隐含）
AI.method: 采用非期望产出SBM模型测算285个城市土地利用效率；运用空间杜宾模型（SDM）分析影响及异质性。
AI.findings: （1）土地利用效率呈上升趋势但存在阶段性变化和空间分异；（2）SO2和PM2.5浓度空间分布显著变化，形成集聚格局；（3）土地利用效率对空气污染有显著负向影响并存在空间溢出效应；（4）影响路径包括土地投入规模、开发强度、产出强度和绿色技术创新；（5）影响效果因城市发展阶段、地理位置和规模呈现异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将土地利用效率与空气污染纳入统一分析框架，揭示了空间溢出效应和多重作用机制，拓展了城市可持续发展理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市制定差异化土地利用政策提供了实证依据，建议从投入和产出两方面优化土地结构，因地制宜推动土地高效利用与空气质量协同改善。

title: Unbenchmarked but Essential: Delegation, Escalation, and Persistence as Intellectual Capabilities

detail.title: Unbenchmarked but Essential: Delegation, Escalation, and Persistence as Intellectual Capabilities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder and CEO of Almma.AI. This paper is conceptual and presents no empirical results; the views expressed are the author's own.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study involved no human participants, animals, or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Intellectual capability, as used throughout this paper, refers to a judgment-bearing, quality-variable cognitive function-one that can be performed with greater or lesser competence, produces observably different outcomes, and cannot be reduced to pre-specified rules. Delegation, escalation, and persistence meet this definition, yet they are treated as implementation details in AI systems. Their systematic exclusion from AI benchmarks is not a gap to be filled later; it is a categorical error that distorts perceptions of AI progress. This paper proposes unbenchmarked intellectual capability as a formal evaluative category and argues that no AI system operating in open-ended, multi-step, or responsibility-bearing workflows can be considered operationally capable without it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“未基准化的智力能力”作为一个正式评估类别，认为委托、升级和坚持等判断性认知功能被系统性地排除在AI基准测试之外，这是一个分类错误，导致对AI进展的认知扭曲。任何在开放式、多步骤或承担责任的流程中运行的AI系统，如果不具备这些能力，就不能被视为具有操作能力。
AI.research_question: AI基准测试中系统性地排除判断性认知功能（委托、升级、坚持）是否是分类错误？这些未被基准化的能力对AI系统的操作能力有何关键影响？
AI.motivation: 当前AI基准测试只关注可预定义规则的认知功能，而忽略了判断性、质量可变的智力能力（如委托、升级和坚持），这扭曲了对AI进展的准确认知。
AI.theoretical_framework: 智力能力定义（判断性、质量可变、不可还原为预设规则）、未基准化的智力能力作为正式评估类别
AI.method: 概念分析与理论论证
AI.findings: 委托、升级和坚持符合智力能力的定义，但被当作AI系统的实施细节而排除在基准测试之外，这是一个分类错误；这些能力对开放式、多步骤或承担责任的AI工作流程至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出“未基准化的智力能力”作为正式的评估类别，纠正了AI评估框架中的分类错误。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI系统在真实世界复杂工作流中的操作能力评估提供了新的理论标准，推动AI基准测试的改进。

title: Equilibrium Existence in Multi-sector Melitz Economies: Sector-specific vs. Mobile Labor
affiliations: Bielefeld University - Department of Business Administration and Economics and

detail.title: Equilibrium Existence in Multi-sector Melitz Economies: Sector-specific vs. Mobile Labor
detail.abstract: We prove equilibrium existence in a many-country, multi-sector Melitz model. We consider two labor-market closures. The sector-specific closure fixes country-sector labor supplies and captures short-to medium-run frictions to cross-sector employment reallocation. The mobilelabor closure is the long-run benchmark: workers move across sectors within countries, a common national wage prevails, and sectoral employment shares are endogenous. Under common primitive restrictions on utility and productivity distributions, equilibrium exists under both closures.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了多国多部门Melitz模型中均衡的存在性，考虑了两种劳动力市场设定：部门特定劳动力（短期到中期）和可流动劳动力（长期基准）。
AI.research_question: 在多国多部门Melitz模型中，不同劳动力市场闭合条件下均衡是否存在？
AI.motivation: Melitz模型是国际贸易理论的重要框架，但多国多部门情形下的均衡存在性尚未得到严格证明，尤其在不同劳动力市场设定下。
AI.theoretical_framework: Melitz异质性企业贸易模型；部门特定劳动力与可流动劳动力两种劳动力市场闭合设定。
AI.method: 理论建模与均衡存在性证明。
AI.findings: 在常见的效用和生产率分布假设下，两种劳动力市场闭合下的均衡均存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次严格证明了多国多部门Melitz模型在两种劳动力市场设定下的均衡存在性，弥补了理论缺口。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际贸易政策的量化分析提供了理论根基，确保模型可解且结果可靠。
